_readme: S357 SkyCanopy, 2026-10-10. Sheet 58 card 1 weighs RCCD's three colleges (Moreno Valley, Norco, Riverside City, all Leading tier, 578 programs) against Long Beach City; either way the harvest needs a read that lists every program in a curriQunet catalog, which 27 colleges use. The pilot reached four Riverside City programs by clicking through the catalog's menus (views at /catalog/alias/rcc-catalog/iq/5852/6117/<id>), one program at a time. This read loads the registry's catalog address and the program section those four views sit in, with "network": true, to learn which address the catalog's own scripts fetch its outline from. No model call; two page loads and the data calls the browser makes for them.

questions.outline_source: Which address the catalog's scripts fetch the outline (sections and program ids) from, and in what shape.
questions.program_section: What the program section lists: each program's title, award and outline id.
